ben-mcadams.biography: Ben McAdams grew up in West Bountiful and has served in the Utah State Senate, as Salt Lake County mayor, and in the U.S. House of Representatives. His campaign website says he lives in Salt Lake City with his wife, Julie, and their four children.
priorities: Housing, health care, and household affordability
